wheel.lug_thread: Wheel bolts (not studs and nuts); earlier Range Rover wheels need the correct flat-seat bolts

items.title: Cam carrier oil channel
items.summary: A blocked oil channel in the cam carrier can cause an oil leak.

items.title: 7-seat second-row seat frame welds
items.summary: On seven-seat trucks, the second-row left seat frame may be insufficiently welded.

items.title: Second-row armrest latch
items.summary: The armrest storage latch may fail in a crash (FMVSS 201).

items.title: Tail-light link
items.summary: A damaged link can stop the tail, brake and turn lights working.

items.title: Rear camera water ingress
items.summary: Water can get into the rear-view camera, giving no image or a distorted one.

items.title: Rear camera drain holes
items.summary: Water may not drain away from the rear-view camera and can damage it. Dealers will drill extra drain holes in the tailgate trim and replace the camera if needed; interim owner letters were due in December 2026.

items.title: Body panels not bonded properly
items.summary: Body panels may not be properly bonded, which reduces structural strength.

items.title: Oil cooler hoses
items.summary: Engine-mounted oil-cooler hoses may not be properly secured and can leak oil onto the road.

items.title: Oil filter housing
items.summary: The oil filter housing can crack and leak oil into the engine bay.

items.title: Transmission oil pressure loss
items.summary: Transmission oil pressure can drop and shift the clutch into neutral, cutting drive.

items.title: MHEV DC-DC converter
items.summary: The mild-hybrid DC-DC converter can fail from electrical overload or a start-up software fault. This follows campaign 26V-248.

items.title: Panoramic roof side finisher
items.summary: The sunroof's side trim may not be properly secured and can detach.

items.title: Driver airbag clockspring connector
items.summary: The clockspring connector can corrode, so the driver's airbag may not deploy as intended.

items.title: Second-row centre buckle
items.summary: The second-row centre seat-belt buckle may not latch correctly.

timeline.change: Revealed on 26 October 2021 at the Royal Opera House in London. MLA-Flex platform, the first Land Rover with all-wheel steering, and BMW's N63 4.4 V8 in the P530.

Production at Solihull from mid-2022. Launch engines: P360/P400 I6 mild hybrids, P530 V8, and P440e/P510e plug-in hybrids (diesels outside the US). A seven-seat LWB followed shortly after launch. Owners say many early trucks were delivered with options deleted during the parts shortage.
Early trucks carry the most open campaigns: seven-seat frame welds, tail-light links, rear-camera water ingress, the cam-carrier oil channel and the armrest latch. Run the VIN.

P550e replaces the P440e and the 615 PS SV arrives. BMW's S68 V8 replaces the N63, and owners rate it more refined. Physical HVAC controls are removed. 2024 trucks have their own recalls (panel bonding, transmission oil pressure, oil filter housing)
JLR announces local Range Rover assembly in Pune, India (May 2024).
Range Rover Electric unveiled on 2 September 2026 after repeated delays: 800 V, twin 260 kW motors and a 118.5 kWh battery.
Range Rover Electric goes on sale in the US as a 2027 model, with 333 miles of EPA range, a 900 mm wading depth and a 5,511 lb towing rating.

identify.intro: Under the same body, L460 powertrains and drivetrain hardware changed in 2024 and vary by trim. That decides refinement, recalls and what you're paying for.

items.head: Which V8
items.body: P530s built for 2022–2023 use BMW's N63 twin-turbo V8. From the 2024 model year the V8 is the newer S68, which is also in the SV P615.

items.head: Which plug-in hybrid
items.body: The P440e and P510e (2022–23) were replaced for 2024 by the P550e. All use a 38.2 kWh battery (31.8 kWh usable). PHEVs aren't offered as seven-seaters.

items.head: Rear differential
items.body: Upper trims get the Electronic Active Differential with torque vectoring. US-spec SE trucks have an open rear diff with torque vectoring by braking.

items.head: Seats and wheelbase
items.body: Four-, five- and seven-seat layouts are available. Seven seats come only on the LWB (3,197 mm wheelbase, 5,252 mm long). The SWB is 2,997 mm.

items.head: Wheels
items.body: The L460 uses wheel bolts, not the L405's studs and nuts. Factory wheels run from 20 to 23 in. Older 5x120 Range Rover wheels fit with the correct flat-seat bolts.

capability.note: P400 and V8s; current PHEV 6,614 lb; Range Rover Electric 5,511 lb
